title.zh: 韩国政府与央行拟年内推动修法，将稳定币纳入支付工具及外汇交易监管
title.en: 韩国政府与央行拟年内推动修法，将稳定币纳入支付工具及外汇交易监管

current_state.zh: South Korea's government and central bank plan to jointly draft a Foreign Exchange Transactions Act amendment by year-end that would subject stablecoins to payment-tool and cross-border FX regulation, backed by a new digital-asset monitoring and reporting system.
current_state.en: South Korea's government and central bank plan to jointly draft a Foreign Exchange Transactions Act amendment by year-end that would subject stablecoins to payment-tool and cross-border FX regulation, backed by a new digital-asset monitoring and reporting system.
